card.name: Start of a recurring schedule phrase
card.fires_on: Small words like "every" or "then", and the word "schedule", right where a repeating interval or follow-up plan is about to be named. Common after an initial dosing or testing timepoint.

modes.label: Linking word before interval
modes.description: "every" or "then" after listed starting weeks or months, just before a repeating interval.
modes.example: Week 0, Week 4, and<< every>> 12 weeks thereafter

modes.label: The word schedule
modes.description: "schedule" naming a plan for follow-up or servicing.
modes.example: the doctor’s recommendations about the<< schedule>> for follow-up care

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning regular, periodic, yearly or routine timing.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a text is about to say how often something repeats.
